projects.title: NAGPRA Repatriation Database & Application
paragraphs: Designed and developed a relational database and application to support the complex information management involved in Native American repatriation. Built a

with 19 foreign-key relationships and 8 workflow views, alongside a Python/Flet interface for searching records, managing information, and generating reports. Grounded in research into NAGPRA requirements, Tribal sovereignty, and the importance of returning ancestors and cultural belongings to their communities.
